name: Node-RED + Home Assistant smart home automations

mentions.name: Node-RED + Home Assistant smart home automations
mentions.description: A smart home automation setup that combines Node-RED and Home Assistant, extended with new sensors, NFC tags, modes, and automations to serve multiple tenants, reduce costs, and automate boring household tasks.
mentions.problem: Automating boring, repetitive household tasks and achieving cost savings for multiple tenants.
mentions.source_excerpt: Moved from nodered only to a hybrid of nodered and home assistant. Added some new sensors, nfc tags, modes and automations for multiple tenants / cost savings. Its been fun to automate some boring tasks.

evidence.value: Moved from nodered only to a hybrid of nodered and home assistant. Added some new sensors, nfc tags, modes and automations for multiple tenants / cost savings. Its been fun to automate some boring tasks.
